groups.description: Force the eligibility/auth gate bits for the CLI gate and authclient.(*EnterpriseAuthValidator).Validate.
groups.precondition: raw+patched site counts must equal expected (cli=2, manager=1); the w2 channelz site must never match.
groups.verify: cli raw==0 & patched==2 ; manager raw==0 & patched==1

groups.description: Retarget Android-seccomp-trapped syscalls: faccessat2 439->48 and fchmodat2 452->53, inside the Go function bodies only.
groups.precondition: each Go ELF must have a parsable pclntab that resolves runtime.memmove; MOVZ X0 must be unique inside the target function.
groups.verify: in every Go ELF: faccessat2 old==0 & new>=1; primary ELF also fchmodat2 old==0 & new>=1

groups.precondition: exactly 2 clean 16-byte occurrences; hits adjacent to / . \ are longer paths and are rejected.
groups.verify: clean target count==0 and replacement count==2

groups.description: Preserve LD_PRELOAD SIGILL handler by skipping Go rt_sigaction for SIGILL (4).
groups.precondition: exactly 2 raw sites in binary (main Go binary + embedded helper Go ELF).

groups.description: Bypass preinit CPU capability fail-fast check and preinit LSE atomic on ARMv8.0-A CPUs.
groups.precondition: exactly 1 raw/patched site for CPU feature check and 1 site for preinit atomic.
groups.verify: cpu_feature raw==0 & repl==1 ; preinit_atomic raw==0 & repl==1
